# Momo

> Momo is a Go ORM (github.com/azrtydxb/momo) that generates typed column and relation descriptors from plain Go structs. v0.3.0 supports PostgreSQL 16/17 with pgvector through pgx only; SQLite and MySQL are not usable. Includes versioned SQL migrations, relations, transactions and vector search. Read the AI guide first. <!-- x-release-please-version -->

## Start here

- [Guide for AI coding agents](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/ai-guide.md): setup, modeling, migrations, queries, relations, vectors, errors, testing, and DO/DON'T rules with every known v0.3.0 pitfall. <!-- x-release-please-version -->
- [README](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/README.md): install, worked example, command line overview.

## Reference

- [Relations](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/relations.md): declaring, loading, filtering and writing relations, with error behavior and limits.
- [Migrations](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/migrations.md): snapshots, apply semantics, locks, failure recovery, production checklist, known issues, CLI reference.
- [Vector search](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/vectors.md): pgvector types, distance functions, index limits, search settings.
- [Full-text search](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/fulltext.md): tsvector column type, match, rank and headline builders, hybrid vector plus text ranking.
- [Projections and tuple rows](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/projections.md): read aggregates, joins and column subsets into projection structs or generic Row1 to Row10 tuple rows, with soft-delete and keyset rules.
- [Go to SQL type mapping](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/TYPE_MAPPING.md): column type per Go type, edge values, null handling.
- [Capabilities](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md): what each database supports, what is not built, what returns ErrUnsupported.
- [Supported versions](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/supported-versions.md): Go, PostgreSQL, pgvector, PgBouncer and pgx versions tested in CI, and the stability policy.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): layers, package names and contracts.

## Features

- INSERT ... SELECT: `Insert[T].FromSelect` with `SelectExprs` or `Select[T]` as the source; composes with `OnConflict`, `Returning` and `Upsert`.
- Typed expressions: `Func`, `Case`, `Cast`, `Concat` and arithmetic work in `Columns`, `GroupBy`, `OrderBy` and `SetExpr` without `momo.SQL`.
- Serial ids: the `serial` tag on an int field gives a PostgreSQL serial column, omitted from inserts and read back with RETURNING.

## Examples

- [Examples index](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/blob/main/examples/README.md): nine runnable programs, each tested end to end in CI.
- [quickstart](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/quickstart): models, generate, CRUD, relations, vector search, a transaction.
- [crud-zero-null](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/crud-zero-null): zero value versus NULL versus default, soft delete, optimistic lock.
- [transactions](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/transactions): Tx, rollback, savepoints, read-only, retry on serialization failure.
- [relations](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/relations): has-many, belongs-to, many-to-many; Load, Preload, Joined, Has, Link, CreateGraph.
- [projection-pagination](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/projection-pagination): projections, keyset pagination, counting.
- [vector-search](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/vector-search): HNSW index, nearest-neighbour queries, filters, search settings.
- [upgrade-database](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/upgrade-database): add a column and an index, rename a column, apply with data kept, drift.
- [custom-sql-migration](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/custom-sql-migration): hand-written migrations, backfill, no-transaction, CONCURRENTLY workaround.
- [adopt-existing-schema](https://github.com/azrtydxb/momo/tree/main/examples/adopt-existing-schema): put a plain-SQL database under Momo with migrate baseline.
